# Purpose and scope

This notebook is the maintained entry point for the ECODA batch-effect
correction comparison. It brings the cell-type abundance diagnostics, MDS
comparisons and ANOSIM summary into one documented analysis. Figures live in
`plots/batch_effect_ECODA_becm_comparison/`, with `boxplots/`, `mds/` and
`summary/` subdirectories. The byte-identical November 11 figures are under
`boxplots/20261111/`; refreshed seven-dataset figures are directly under
`boxplots/`. Historical source receipts, frozen execution
snapshots and checksum inventories remain in their original run directories.

The seven physical datasets are Alzheimer, Breast_cancer, Covid19_PBMC,
Joanito, Kidney_KPMP_full, Lupus_PBMC and Stephenson. Lung is excluded. Kidney's
main biological evaluation is `condition.l1`; the partly batch-confounded
tissue evaluation is not pooled into this comparison. Dataset columns and
participation come from the top-level `datasets.json` contract.

This is an exploratory sample-level comparison of existing composition
results. Biological labels colour plots and evaluate sample distances only.
They never select cell types, enter correction, or define embeddings. No
donor adjustment or biological covariates are introduced in this first pass.
Existing inputs, original result bundles and annotations are preserved.

## Input and execution contract

Use a checksum-validated, run-owned cache containing compact distances,
sample metadata, scores and grouped boxplot statistics. Full H5AD files,
expression matrices and pseudobulks do not belong on the workstation. The
scientific calculations operate dataset-by-dataset on Bamboo; the local
plotting chunks consume the compact cache. Neither sourcing this notebook nor
rendering its prose submits scheduler work.

The default is the reviewed local cache from this initial test. Run setup,
core, plotting functions and cache loading once, then execute only the plotting
chunk being changed in a persistent Pixi R session. This needs no HPC work.
Environment variables can override the cache or disable rendering.

```{r becm-setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
if (basename(getwd()) == "notebooks") setwd("..")
becm_plot_root <- file.path(getwd(), "plots", "batch_effect_ECODA_becm_comparison")
becm_render <- identical(Sys.getenv("ECODA_BECM_RENDER", "1"), "1")
becm_default_cache <- file.path(getwd(), "data", "derived", "ECODA_becm_comp_20261116_v1", "comparison_cache.rds")
becm_default_cache_md5 <- "d22ed3205de4b439f4063f1b88f37ebf"
becm_dataset_ids <- c("Alzheimer", "Breast_cancer", "Covid19_PBMC", "Joanito",
                   "Kidney_KPMP_full", "Lupus_PBMC", "Stephenson")
stopifnot(requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly=TRUE),
          requireNamespace("patchwork", quietly=TRUE),
          requireNamespace("jsonlite", quietly=TRUE))
```

# Scientific definition of the variants

Each original CLR composition uses the existing count + 0.5 pseudocount.
For two varying batch groups the screen uses a two-sided unpaired Wilcoxon
rank-sum test; with more than two groups it uses Kruskal-Wallis. Both raw and
BH-adjusted p-values are reported. A correction family contains all original
cell types of one dataset and one composition source. Constant cell types
receive p=1.

For cell type `j`, the effect-size filter is the maximum difference between
batch medians of its original CLR coordinate:

`delta_j = max(batch median CLR_j) - min(batch median CLR_j)`.

The `sigdiff_ctdrop_t` variants remove the union of cell types satisfying
`BH-adjusted p < 0.05` **and** `delta_j >= t`. With several batches, one large
pairwise median difference is sufficient; the omnibus p-value does not claim
that every pair differs. The screen is calculated once on the original
composition, not repeated after each removal. CLR is recomputed from the
remaining categories with the same +0.5 pseudocount applied exactly once.
No biological labels enter the screen.

The author family starts from original author annotations. The Harmony family
starts from the existing Harmony-derived Leiden composition, before sample
CLR limma correction. These drop variants do not additionally apply limma.
The author threshold-2 `droplow50pct` variant additionally removes every type
with zero observed cells in at least 50% of all samples. Its sparse screen
uses original counts, before pseudocount addition; it is combined with the
threshold-2 removal as a union.

The fixed comparators are author CLR + limma, Harmony/Leiden CLR, and
Harmony/Leiden CLR + limma. The uncorrected anchors are author CLR and
non-Harmony PCA/Leiden CLR. All Harmony rows use that same non-Harmony
uncorrected anchor. Existing correction endpoints are reused rather than
refitted.

```{r becm-core}
becm_datasets <- function() c("Alzheimer", "Breast_cancer", "Covid19_PBMC", "Joanito",
  "Kidney_KPMP_full", "Lupus_PBMC", "Stephenson")

becm_threshold_id <- function(x) format(x, trim = TRUE, scientific = FALSE)

becm_screen <- function(clr, batch, counts) {
  stopifnot(is.matrix(clr), is.numeric(clr), all(is.finite(clr)),
    nrow(clr) == length(batch), ncol(clr) >= 1L, !anyNA(batch), all(nzchar(trimws(batch))),
    !is.null(rownames(clr)), all(nzchar(trimws(rownames(clr)))), !anyDuplicated(rownames(clr)),
    !is.null(colnames(clr)), all(nzchar(trimws(colnames(clr)))), !anyDuplicated(colnames(clr)),
    identical(dimnames(counts), dimnames(clr)), all(is.finite(counts)),
    all(counts >= 0), all(counts == round(counts)))
  group <- factor(batch)
  stopifnot(nlevels(group) >= 2L, all(table(group) >= 2L))
  rows <- lapply(seq_len(ncol(clr)), function(j) {
    y <- clr[, j]
    constant <- length(unique(y)) == 1L
    value <- if (constant) list(statistic = 0, p.value = 1) else if (nlevels(group) == 2L) {
      stats::wilcox.test(y ~ group, exact = FALSE, correct = TRUE)
    } else stats::kruskal.test(y ~ group)
    medians <- tapply(y, group, stats::median)
    data.frame(cell_type = colnames(clr)[j], p = value$p.value,
      statistic = unname(value$statistic), median_clr_range = max(medians) - min(medians),
      zero_fraction = mean(counts[, j] == 0),
      test = if (nlevels(group) == 2L) "Wilcoxon rank-sum" else "Kruskal-Wallis",
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  })
  result <- do.call(rbind, rows)
  result$p_bh <- stats::p.adjust(result$p, "BH")
  result$q <- result$p_bh
  stopifnot(all(is.finite(result$p)), all(is.finite(result$p_bh)))
  result
}

becm_drop <- function(clr, screen, cutoff, drop_sparse = FALSE) {
  stopifnot(length(cutoff) == 1L, is.finite(cutoff), cutoff >= 0,
    identical(colnames(clr), screen$cell_type), length(drop_sparse) == 1L,
    is.logical(drop_sparse), !is.na(drop_sparse))
  significant <- screen$p_bh < 0.05
  remove_diff <- significant & screen$median_clr_range >= cutoff
  remove_sparse <- drop_sparse & screen$zero_fraction >= 0.5
  keep <- !(remove_diff | remove_sparse)
  features <- clr[, keep, drop = FALSE]
  # Recenter the retained log ratios; the original +0.5 is never added again.
  if (sum(keep) >= 2L) features <- features - rowMeans(features)
  status <- if (sum(keep) < 2L) "UNSCORABLE_TOO_FEW_TYPES" else if (
    max(as.matrix(stats::dist(features))) <= 1e-12) "UNSCORABLE_IDENTICAL_SAMPLES" else "PASS"
  list(feat_mat = features, status = status, n_initial = ncol(clr),
    n_significant = sum(significant), n_dropped = sum(!keep), n_remaining = sum(keep),
    n_sparse_dropped = sum(remove_sparse), removed_types = colnames(clr)[!keep],
    differential_removed_types = colnames(clr)[remove_diff],
    sparse_removed_types = colnames(clr)[remove_sparse])
}

becm_variant <- function(features, family, state, threshold = NA_real_, counts = NULL) {
  if (is.null(counts)) counts <- list(n_initial = ncol(features), n_significant = NA_integer_,
    n_dropped = 0L, n_remaining = ncol(features), n_sparse_dropped = 0L,
    removed_types = character(), differential_removed_types = character(), sparse_removed_types = character())
  status <- if (!is.null(counts$status)) counts$status else if (ncol(features) < 2L) {
    "UNSCORABLE_TOO_FEW_TYPES"
  } else if (max(as.matrix(stats::dist(features))) <= 1e-12) "UNSCORABLE_IDENTICAL_SAMPLES" else "PASS"
  distance <- if (status == "PASS") stats::dist(features) else NULL
  list(family = family, state = state, threshold = threshold, status = status,
    dist_mat = distance, n_initial = counts$n_initial, n_significant = counts$n_significant,
    n_dropped = counts$n_dropped, n_remaining = counts$n_remaining,
    n_sparse_dropped = counts$n_sparse_dropped, removed_types = counts$removed_types,
    differential_removed_types = counts$differential_removed_types,
    sparse_removed_types = counts$sparse_removed_types)
}

becm_build_variants <- function(inputs, batch) {
  stopifnot(identical(names(inputs), c("authors", "leiden", "authors_limma", "harmony", "harmony_limma")))
  ids <- rownames(inputs$authors$clr)
  stopifnot(!is.null(ids), length(ids) >= 3L, !anyNA(ids), all(nzchar(trimws(ids))), !anyDuplicated(ids))
  stopifnot(all(vapply(inputs, function(x) identical(rownames(x$clr), ids) &&
    is.matrix(x$clr) && all(is.finite(x$clr)), logical(1))))
  screens <- list(authors = becm_screen(inputs$authors$clr, batch, inputs$authors$counts),
    harmony = becm_screen(inputs$harmony$clr, batch, inputs$harmony$counts))
  variants <- list(
    ECODA_authors_uncorrected = becm_variant(inputs$authors$clr, "authors_uncorrected", "uncorrected"),
    ECODA_Leiden_CLR_uncorrected = becm_variant(inputs$leiden$clr, "leiden_uncorrected", "uncorrected"),
    ECODA_authors_limma = becm_variant(inputs$authors_limma$clr, "authors_limma", "corrected"),
    ECODA_Harmony_Leiden_CLR = becm_variant(inputs$harmony$clr, "harmony", "corrected"),
    ECODA_Harmony_Leiden_CLR_limma = becm_variant(inputs$harmony_limma$clr, "harmony_limma", "corrected"))
  for (family in c("authors", "harmony")) for (cutoff in seq(0, 4, by = 0.5)) {
    source <- inputs[[family]]$clr
    filtered <- becm_drop(source, screens[[family]], cutoff)
    prefix <- if (family == "authors") "ECODA_authors_sigdiff_ctdrop_" else "ECODA_Harmony_Leiden_CLR_sigdiff_ctdrop_"
    variants[[paste0(prefix, becm_threshold_id(cutoff))]] <- becm_variant(filtered$feat_mat,
      paste0(family, "_drop"), "corrected", cutoff, filtered)
  }
  sparse <- becm_drop(inputs$authors$clr, screens$authors, 2, drop_sparse = TRUE)
  variants$ECODA_authors_sigdiff_ctdrop_2_droplow50pct <- becm_variant(sparse$feat_mat,
    "authors_drop_sparse", "corrected", 2, sparse)
  stopifnot(length(variants) == 24L, !anyDuplicated(names(variants)))
  list(variants = variants, screens = screens)
}

becm_anosim <- function(distance, labels) {
  stopifnot(inherits(distance, "dist"), !anyNA(labels), length(labels) == attr(distance, "Size"))
  group <- factor(labels)
  stopifnot(nlevels(group) >= 2L, nlevels(group) < length(labels))
  # Only R is requested, not a permutation p-value; R does not depend on permutations.
  value <- unname(vegan::anosim(distance, group, permutations = 0, parallel = 1)$statistic)
  stopifnot(length(value) == 1L, is.finite(value), value >= -1 - 1e-8, value <= 1 + 1e-8)
  value
}

becm_score_variants <- function(variants, metadata, dataset) {
  stopifnot(identical(names(metadata), c("Sample", "bio", "batch")),
    !anyNA(metadata), !anyDuplicated(metadata$Sample))
  rows <- lapply(names(variants), function(key) {
    v <- variants[[key]]
    biological <- technical <- NA_real_
    if (v$status == "PASS") {
      stopifnot(identical(attr(v$dist_mat, "Labels"), metadata$Sample))
      biological <- becm_anosim(v$dist_mat, metadata$bio)
      technical <- becm_anosim(v$dist_mat, metadata$batch)
    }
    data.frame(dataset = dataset, method_id = key, family = v$family, state = v$state,
      threshold = v$threshold, status = v$status, biological_anosim = biological,
      batch_anosim = technical, n_initial = v$n_initial, n_significant = v$n_significant,
      n_dropped = v$n_dropped, n_remaining = v$n_remaining, n_sparse_dropped = v$n_sparse_dropped)
  })
  do.call(rbind, rows)
}

becm_box_summary <- function(clr, counts, batch, screen, dataset) {
  selected <- screen$cell_type[screen$p < 0.05]
  selected <- selected[order(screen$p[match(selected, screen$cell_type)])]
  results <- screen[match(selected, screen$cell_type), , drop = FALSE]
  # Keep every test in the result table so BH always has its original family.
  results <- screen[order(screen$q, screen$p, screen$cell_type), , drop = FALSE]
  proportions <- counts / rowSums(counts)
  rows <- summaries <- list()
  for (g in sort(unique(batch))) {
    ix <- which(batch == g)
    summaries[[g]] <- data.frame(batch = g, n_samples = length(ix), cell_type = colnames(clr),
      mean_clr = colMeans(clr[ix, , drop = FALSE]), median_clr = apply(clr[ix, , drop = FALSE], 2, median),
      mean_proportion = colMeans(proportions[ix, , drop = FALSE]),
      median_proportion = apply(proportions[ix, , drop = FALSE], 2, median),
      prevalence = colMeans(counts[ix, , drop = FALSE] > 0), row.names = NULL)
  }
  for (scale in if (dataset == "Stephenson") c("CLR", "Percentage") else "CLR") {
    values <- if (scale == "CLR") clr else proportions * 100
    for (ct in selected) for (g in sort(unique(batch))) {
      y <- values[batch == g, ct]
      box <- grDevices::boxplot.stats(y)
      rows[[length(rows) + 1L]] <- data.frame(scale = scale, cell_type = ct, batch = g,
        n = length(y), ymin = box$stats[1], lower = box$stats[2], middle = box$stats[3],
        upper = box$stats[4], ymax = box$stats[5], minimum = min(y), maximum = max(y), n_outliers = length(box$out))
    }
  }
  list(dataset = dataset, results = results, boxes = if (length(rows)) do.call(rbind, rows) else data.frame(),
    batch_summaries = do.call(rbind, summaries), n_samples = nrow(clr), n_types = ncol(clr),
    batch_counts = as.list(table(batch)),
    proportion_tests = if (dataset == "Stephenson") becm_screen(proportions, batch, counts) else NULL)
}

becm_checked_rds <- function(path, md5) {
  check <- function() stopifnot(file.exists(path), file.info(path)$size > 0,
    identical(unname(tools::md5sum(path)), md5))
  check(); value <- readRDS(path); check(); value
}

becm_native_input <- function(row, ids, expected_columns = NULL) {
  receipt <- becm_checked_rds(row$receipt_path, row$receipt_md5)
  stopifnot(identical(receipt$status, "reviewed"), identical(receipt$md5, row$md5),
    identical(receipt$artifact_path, row$artifact_path), identical(receipt$bundle_key, row$bundle_key))
  value <- becm_checked_rds(row$artifact_path, row$md5)[[row$bundle_key]]
  clr <- as.matrix(value$feat_mat)
  stopifnot(is.numeric(clr), all(is.finite(clr)), !is.null(rownames(clr)),
    all(nzchar(trimws(rownames(clr)))), !anyDuplicated(rownames(clr)),
    setequal(rownames(clr), ids), !is.null(colnames(clr)), !anyDuplicated(colnames(clr)))
  d <- as.matrix(value$dist_mat)
  stopifnot(identical(rownames(d), rownames(clr)), identical(colnames(d), rownames(clr)),
    all(is.finite(d)), all(d >= 0), max(abs(d - t(d))) < 1e-10,
    max(abs(diag(d))) < 1e-10, max(abs(as.matrix(stats::dist(clr)) - d)) < 1e-8)
  clr <- clr[ids, , drop = FALSE]
  counts <- NULL
  if (!is.null(value$counts)) {
    padded <- as.matrix(value$counts)
    stopifnot(!is.null(rownames(padded)), !anyDuplicated(rownames(padded)),
      setequal(rownames(padded), ids), !is.null(colnames(padded)), !anyDuplicated(colnames(padded)))
    padded <- padded[ids, , drop = FALSE]
    stopifnot(ncol(padded) == ncol(clr), all(is.finite(padded)), all(padded >= 0.5),
      max(abs(padded - 0.5 - round(padded - 0.5))) < 1e-8)
    stopifnot(identical(colnames(clr), colnames(padded)) ||
      identical(colnames(clr), make.names(colnames(padded), unique = TRUE)))
    if (!is.null(expected_columns)) stopifnot(identical(colnames(padded), expected_columns))
    # The bundle may sanitize CLR names; count-column names remain author labels.
    colnames(clr) <- colnames(padded)
    counts <- padded - 0.5
    if (row$role %in% c("authors", "leiden", "harmony"))
      stopifnot(max(abs(unname(clr) - unname(log(padded) - rowMeans(log(padded))))) < 1e-8)
  }
  list(clr = clr, counts = counts)
}

becm_run_dataset <- function(selection) {
  stopifnot(selection$dataset %in% becm_datasets(),
    identical(names(selection$inputs), c("authors", "leiden", "authors_limma", "harmony", "harmony_limma")))
  metadata <- selection$metadata
  stopifnot(identical(names(metadata), c("Sample", "bio", "batch")), !anyNA(metadata),
    !anyDuplicated(metadata$Sample), nrow(metadata) == selection$n_samples)
  inputs <- lapply(selection$inputs, function(row) becm_native_input(row, metadata$Sample, row$cell_type_names))
  # Shared producer identities are checked, not inferred from matching dimensions.
  stopifnot(identical(inputs$authors$counts, inputs$authors_limma$counts),
    identical(inputs$harmony$counts, inputs$harmony_limma$counts))
  built <- becm_build_variants(inputs, metadata$batch)
  scores <- becm_score_variants(built$variants, metadata, selection$dataset)
  boxes <- becm_box_summary(inputs$authors$clr, inputs$authors$counts, metadata$batch,
    built$screens$authors, selection$dataset)
  # No CLR features or counts are returned to the workstation.
  list(schema = "ecoda_becm_comp_dataset_v1", dataset = selection$dataset,
    metadata = metadata, variants = built$variants, screens = built$screens,
    scores = scores, boxplots = boxes, sources = selection$inputs,
    policy = list(alpha = 0.05, adjustment = "BH within initial annotation family",
      effect = "max batch median CLR - min batch median CLR", pseudocount = 0.5,
      recenter_after_drop = TRUE, retest = FALSE, sparse_zero_fraction = 0.5,
      donor_adjustment = FALSE, evaluation = "primary condition only",
      lupus = "whole-sample majority_v1, as approved"))
}

becm_worker <- function(selection_path, selection_md5, output_dir, run_id,
                        source_commit, code_md5, code_path) {
  stopifnot(nzchar(run_id), grepl("^[a-f0-9]{40}$", source_commit),
    identical(unname(tools::md5sum(code_path)), code_md5),
    getRversion() == "4.5.2", requireNamespace("vegan", quietly = TRUE))
  selection <- becm_checked_rds(selection_path, selection_md5)
  stopifnot(identical(names(selection), becm_datasets()), dir.exists(output_dir))
  index <- list()
  for (ds in names(selection)) {
    path <- file.path(output_dir, paste0(ds, ".rds"))
    proof <- paste0(path, ".md5")
    if (file.exists(path) || file.exists(proof)) {
      stopifnot(file.exists(path), file.exists(proof))
      md5 <- readLines(proof, warn = FALSE)
      value <- becm_checked_rds(path, md5)
      stopifnot(identical(value$run_identity$run_id, run_id),
        identical(value$run_identity$selection_md5, selection_md5),
        identical(value$run_identity$source_commit, source_commit),
        identical(value$run_identity$code_md5, code_md5))
    } else {
      value <- becm_run_dataset(selection[[ds]])
      value$run_identity <- list(run_id = run_id, selection_md5 = selection_md5,
        source_commit = source_commit, code_md5 = code_md5,
        R = R.version.string, vegan = as.character(utils::packageVersion("vegan")),
        host = Sys.info()[["nodename"]], job_id = Sys.getenv("SLURM_JOB_ID"),
        time_utc = format(Sys.time(), tz = "UTC", usetz = TRUE))
      tmp <- tempfile(".becm-", tmpdir = output_dir)
      saveRDS(value, tmp, version = 3)
      stopifnot(file.rename(tmp, path))
      md5 <- unname(tools::md5sum(path))
      proof_tmp <- tempfile(".becm-md5-", tmpdir = output_dir)
      writeLines(md5, proof_tmp)
      stopifnot(file.rename(proof_tmp, proof))
    }
    stopifnot(identical(value$schema, "ecoda_becm_comp_dataset_v1"),
      identical(value$metadata, selection[[ds]]$metadata), length(value$variants) == 24L,
      nrow(value$scores) == 24L, !anyDuplicated(value$scores$method_id))
    index[[ds]] <- data.frame(dataset = ds, file = basename(path),
      md5 = unname(tools::md5sum(path)), size = file.info(path)$size,
      n_variants = 24L, n_unscorable = sum(value$scores$status != "PASS"))
    cat(ds, ":", sum(value$scores$status == "PASS"), "/24 scorable variants\n")
    flush.console()
    rm(value); invisible(gc(FALSE))
  }
  manifest <- do.call(rbind, index)
  path <- file.path(output_dir, "outputs.tsv")
  if (file.exists(path)) {
    stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(read.delim(path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
      `rownames<-`(manifest, NULL), check.attributes = FALSE)))
  } else {
    tmp <- tempfile(".becm-index-", tmpdir = output_dir)
    write.table(manifest, tmp, sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
    stopifnot(file.rename(tmp, path))
  }
  invisible(manifest)
}

becm_prepare_selection <- function(control_path, control_md5, config_path = "datasets.json") {
  e <- new.env(parent = globalenv())
  for (path in c("src/utils/datasets_io.R", "src/utils/analysis_release.R"))
    sys.source(path, envir = e)
  control <- becm_checked_rds(control_path, control_md5)
  stopifnot(identical(control$status, "approved"),
    identical(control$schema, "ecoda_batch_analysis_release_v1"))
  registry <- e$read_datasets_json(config_path)
  roles <- list(authors = c("batch_effect_uncorrected", "ECODA_authors_HR"),
    leiden = c("batch_effect_uncorrected", "ECODA_seuratres_2"),
    authors_limma = c("batch_effect_corrected", "ECODA_authors_HR"),
    harmony = c("batch_effect_corrected", "ecoda_unsupervised_harmony"),
    harmony_limma = c("batch_effect_corrected", "ecoda_unsupervised_harmony_limma"))
  result <- setNames(vector("list", length(becm_datasets())), becm_datasets())
  for (ds in names(result)) {
    cfg <- registry[[ds]]
    stopifnot(!startsWith(ds, "_"), isTRUE(cfg$use_for_batch_effect),
      all(c("batch_effect_uncorrected", "batch_effect_corrected") %in% names(cfg$views)))
    wanted <- data.frame(dataset = ds, view = c(vapply(roles, `[`, character(1), 1),
      "batch_effect_uncorrected", "batch_effect_corrected"),
      method_key = c(vapply(roles, `[`, character(1), 2), rep("__sample_metadata__", 2)),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    keys <- e$.analysis_key(wanted)
    rows <- control$ledger[e$.analysis_key(control$ledger) %in% keys, , drop = FALSE]
    scope <- control$expected_scope[e$.analysis_key(control$expected_scope) %in% keys, , drop = FALSE]
    stopifnot(nrow(rows) == 7L, nrow(scope) == 7L)
    loaded <- e$load_analysis_release(rows, scope, require_projection = TRUE)
    entry <- function(view, key) loaded[[paste(ds, view, key, sep = "\r")]]
    unc <- entry("batch_effect_uncorrected", "__sample_metadata__")$result$metadata
    cor <- entry("batch_effect_corrected", "__sample_metadata__")$result$metadata
    stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(unc$Sample), !anyDuplicated(cor$Sample), setequal(unc$Sample, cor$Sample))
    cor <- cor[match(unc$Sample, cor$Sample), , drop = FALSE]
    batch_columns <- unlist(cfg$batch_col)
    batch_columns <- batch_columns[vapply(batch_columns,
      function(b) length(unique(unc[[b]])) > 1L, logical(1))]
    stopifnot(length(batch_columns) == 1L,
      identical(as.character(unc[[cfg$label_col]]), as.character(cor[[cfg$label_col]])),
      identical(as.character(unc[[batch_columns]]), as.character(cor[[batch_columns]])))
    metadata <- data.frame(Sample = as.character(unc$Sample), bio = as.character(unc[[cfg$label_col]]),
      batch = as.character(unc[[batch_columns]]), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    inputs <- lapply(names(roles), function(role) {
      k <- roles[[role]]; value <- entry(k[1], k[2])
      proof <- e$.analysis_checked_file(value$receipt$evidence_path, value$receipt$evidence_md5)
      parent <- readRDS(proof)$parent
      stopifnot(identical(parent$dataset, ds), identical(parent$view, k[1]),
        identical(parent$method_key, k[2]))
      list(role = role, artifact_path = parent$artifact_path, md5 = parent$md5,
        bundle_key = parent$bundle_key, receipt_path = parent$receipt_path,
        receipt_md5 = parent$receipt_md5, cell_type_names = value$result$cell_type_names)
    })
    names(inputs) <- names(roles)
    result[[ds]] <- list(dataset = ds, n_samples = nrow(metadata), metadata = metadata,
      inputs = inputs, columns = list(sample = cfg$sample_col, bio = cfg$label_col, batch = batch_columns),
      control_md5 = control_md5, config_md5 = unname(tools::md5sum(config_path)))
    rm(loaded, unc, cor, metadata, inputs); invisible(gc(FALSE))
  }
  result
}

becm_read_cache <- function(root, index_md5) {
  index_path <- file.path(root, "outputs.tsv")
  stopifnot(identical(unname(tools::md5sum(index_path)), index_md5))
  index <- read.delim(index_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  stopifnot(identical(index$dataset, becm_datasets()), nrow(index) == 7L,
    !anyDuplicated(index$file), all(index$n_variants == 24L))
  datasets <- boxes <- setNames(vector("list", 7L), becm_datasets())
  scores <- list()
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(index))) {
    stopifnot(identical(index$file[i], paste0(index$dataset[i], ".rds")))
    path <- file.path(root, index$file[i])
    value <- becm_checked_rds(path, index$md5[i])
    stopifnot(identical(value$schema, "ecoda_becm_comp_dataset_v1"),
      identical(value$dataset, index$dataset[i]), nrow(value$scores) == 24L,
      identical(file.info(path)$size, as.numeric(index$size[i])))
    datasets[[i]] <- value[c("metadata", "variants", "screens", "sources", "policy", "run_identity")]
    boxes[[i]] <- value$boxplots
    scores[[i]] <- value$scores
    rm(value)
  }
  list(schema = "ecoda_becm_comp_cache_v1", datasets = datasets,
    scores = do.call(rbind, scores), boxplots = boxes,
    output_index = index, output_index_md5 = index_md5)
}
```

# Prepare the scoped Bamboo calculation

The calculation is the approved initial noncanonical scoring test. It reads
existing sample-composition bundles on a Bamboo compute allocation, preserves
all native outputs, and checkpoints one compact result per dataset. It does
not run a pipeline submitter or refit preprocessing, annotation, Harmony or
limma. ANOSIM uses `permutations=0`: only its deterministic R statistic is
needed here. The generated worker is a frozen copy of this notebook's core,
with the notebook revision, selection MD5 and worker MD5 recorded. Maintain
the notebook, not the generated worker.

Run the following preparation chunk explicitly after committing the notebook.
Transfer only the generated `selection.rds` and `worker.R` to a new run-owned
Bamboo directory. Execute that worker with the configured Pixi R on a compute
allocation, from a checkout/snapshot of the recorded commit. Its six arguments
are the remote selection path, selection MD5, remote output directory, run ID,
full source commit and worker MD5. It writes seven compact RDS files, their
checksum sidecars and `outputs.tsv`. Copy only those output files back.

```{r becm-prepare-run, eval=FALSE}
run_id <- "ECODA_becm_comp_20261116_v1"
run_root <- file.path(getwd(), "data", "derived", run_id)
dir.create(run_root, recursive=TRUE, showWarnings=FALSE)
source_commit <- system2("git", c("rev-parse", "HEAD"), stdout=TRUE)
stopifnot(grepl("^[a-f0-9]{40}$", source_commit),
  system2("git", c("diff", "--quiet", "HEAD", "--",
    "notebooks/batch_effect_ECODA_becm_comparison.rmd")) == 0L)
selection <- becm_prepare_selection(
  "data/derived/batch_majority_metadata_v3/batch_analysis_release.rds",
  "e75b1036df9d80d21cd633058957f55f")
selection_path <- file.path(run_root, "selection.rds")
if (file.exists(selection_path)) {
  stopifnot(identical(readRDS(selection_path), selection))
} else saveRDS(selection, selection_path)
notebook_path <- "notebooks/batch_effect_ECODA_becm_comparison.rmd"
lines <- readLines(notebook_path)
start <- grep("^```\\{r becm-core[,}]", lines)
stopifnot(length(start) == 1L)
end <- start + which(grepl("^```[[:space:]]*$", lines[(start+1):length(lines)]))[1L]
worker <- c(lines[(start+1):(end-1)],
  "args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly=TRUE)", "stopifnot(length(args)==6L)",
  "script <- sub('^--file=', '', grep('^--file=', commandArgs(), value=TRUE)[1L])",
  "becm_worker(args[1], args[2], args[3], args[4], args[5], args[6], normalizePath(script))")
worker_path <- file.path(run_root, "worker.R")
if (file.exists(worker_path)) {
  stopifnot(identical(readLines(worker_path), worker))
} else writeLines(worker, worker_path)
run_identity <- list(run_id=run_id, source_commit=source_commit,
  notebook_md5=unname(tools::md5sum(notebook_path)),
  selection_md5=unname(tools::md5sum(selection_path)),
  worker_md5=unname(tools::md5sum(worker_path)),
  selected_datasets=becm_datasets(), expected_rows=7L * 24L,
  execution="Scoped temporary noncanonical sample-composition comparison on Bamboo")
saveRDS(run_identity, file.path(run_root, "run_identity.rds"))
print(run_identity)
```

After the compact output transfer, verify `outputs.tsv` against its recorded
MD5 and assemble the plotting cache. It contains distances, scores, labels,
tests and grouped summaries, never sample CLR/count matrices.

```{r becm-assemble-cache, eval=FALSE}
output_root <- file.path(run_root, "outputs")
output_index_md5 <- Sys.getenv("ECODA_BECM_OUTPUT_INDEX_MD5")
becm_cache <- becm_read_cache(output_root, output_index_md5)
cache_path <- file.path(run_root, "comparison_cache.rds")
if (file.exists(cache_path)) {
  stopifnot(identical(readRDS(cache_path), becm_cache))
} else saveRDS(becm_cache, cache_path)
Sys.setenv(ECODA_BECM_CACHE=cache_path,
  ECODA_BECM_CACHE_MD5=unname(tools::md5sum(cache_path)), ECODA_BECM_RENDER="1")
```

# Plotting functions

The boxplot implementation below replaces the former free-standing
`plot_boxplots.R`. It accepts explicit payloads instead of relying on a
resident `batch_boxes` object. It retains the original Tukey hinges, extreme
outlier markers, p-value labels and pooled zero-count bars. Dataset and panel
counts are derived from the payloads rather than hard-coded. Before removing
that old helper, all 125 main boxplots and their zero bars were checked for
numerical equivalence against the original plotting layers. Its exact source
bytes remain in the frozen plotting-migration receipt.

```{r becm-plot-functions}
becm_pformat <- function(x) vapply(x, function(z) {
  if (is.na(z)) "NA" else if (z < 0.001) formatC(z, format="e", digits=1)
  else format(signif(z, 2), trim=TRUE, scientific=FALSE)
}, character(1))

becm_axisformat <- function(x) format(signif(x, 2), trim=TRUE, scientific=FALSE)

becm_short_batch <- function(dataset, batch) {
  if (dataset == "Alzheimer") return(ifelse(batch == "10x 3' v3", "3' v3", "Multiome"))
  if (dataset == "Breast_cancer") return(ifelse(batch == "12 hour", "12 h", "15 min"))
  if (dataset == "Lupus_PBMC") return(sub("dmx_", "", sub("YS-JY-", "", sub("_pool", "p", batch))))
  batch
}

becm_save_pages <- function(pages, path, width, height) {
  stopifnot(length(pages) > 0L, !dir.exists(path))
  dir.create(dirname(path), recursive=TRUE, showWarnings=FALSE)
  tmp <- tempfile(".becm-", tmpdir=dirname(path), fileext=".pdf")
  on.exit(unlink(tmp))
  grDevices::pdf(tmp, width=width, height=height, onefile=TRUE, useDingbats=FALSE)
  tryCatch(for (page in pages) print(page), finally=grDevices::dev.off())
  stopifnot(file.info(tmp)$size > 0, file.rename(tmp, path))
  invisible(path)
}

becm_boxplot_pages <- function(payload, dataset, scale="CLR") {
  selected <- payload$results$cell_type[payload$results$p < 0.05]
  if (!length(selected)) {
    return(list(ggplot2::ggplot() + ggplot2::theme_void() +
      ggplot2::labs(title=paste(dataset, "| No cell types with raw CLR p < 0.05"))))
  }
  tests <- if (scale == "CLR") payload$results else payload$proportion_tests
  stopifnot(is.data.frame(tests), !anyDuplicated(tests$cell_type))
  tests <- tests[match(selected, tests$cell_type), , drop=FALSE]
  boxes <- payload$boxes[payload$boxes$scale == scale, , drop=FALSE]
  batches <- sort(unique(boxes$batch))
  batch_labels <- paste0(becm_short_batch(dataset, batches), "\nn=",
    vapply(batches, function(b) as.integer(payload$batch_counts[[b]]), integer(1)))
  panels <- lapply(seq_along(selected), function(j) {
    cell_type <- selected[j]
    box <- boxes[boxes$cell_type == cell_type, , drop=FALSE]
    box$batch_display <- factor(box$batch, levels=batches, labels=batch_labels)
    prev <- payload$batch_summaries[payload$batch_summaries$cell_type == cell_type, , drop=FALSE]
    zero <- sum(round(prev$n_samples * (1 - prev$prevalence)))
    n <- sum(prev$n_samples)
    zero_pct <- 100 * zero / n
    stopifnot(n == payload$n_samples, zero >= 0, zero <= n,
      nrow(box) == length(batches), all(box$ymin <= box$lower),
      all(box$lower <= box$middle), all(box$middle <= box$upper),
      all(box$upper <= box$ymax), is.finite(tests$p[j]), is.finite(tests$q[j]))
    status <- if (tests$q[j] < 0.05) "BH significant" else if (tests$p[j] < 0.05) "Raw only" else "Neither"
    fill <- c("BH significant"="#71A8CF", "Raw only"="#EBC579", "Neither"="#CCCCCC")[[status]]
    extrema <- rbind(
      data.frame(batch_display=box$batch_display[box$minimum < box$ymin], value=box$minimum[box$minimum < box$ymin]),
      data.frame(batch_display=box$batch_display[box$maximum > box$ymax], value=box$maximum[box$maximum > box$ymax]))
    top <- ggplot2::ggplot(box, ggplot2::aes(x=batch_display)) +
      ggplot2::geom_boxplot(ggplot2::aes(ymin=ymin, lower=lower, middle=middle,
        upper=upper, ymax=ymax), stat="identity", fill=fill, width=.55, linewidth=.35) +
      ggplot2::geom_point(data=extrema, ggplot2::aes(x=batch_display, y=value),
        inherit.aes=FALSE, shape=4, size=1, stroke=.35, colour="#666666") +
      ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(labels=becm_axisformat, breaks=scales::breaks_pretty(n=4),
        expand=ggplot2::expansion(mult=c(.08, .08))) +
      ggplot2::labs(title=cell_type, subtitle=paste0("p = ", becm_pformat(tests$p[j]),
        "   BH = ", becm_pformat(tests$q[j])), x=NULL,
        y=if (scale == "CLR") "CLR abundance" else "Cell abundance (%)") +
      ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size=9) +
      ggplot2::theme(plot.title=ggplot2::element_text(size=10.5, face="bold"),
        plot.subtitle=ggplot2::element_text(size=9), panel.grid.minor=ggplot2::element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.x=ggplot2::element_blank(),
        axis.text.x=ggplot2::element_text(size=8, angle=if (length(batches) > 3) 45 else 0,
          hjust=if (length(batches) > 3) 1 else .5), plot.margin=ggplot2::margin(5, 8, 1, 5))
    bottom <- ggplot2::ggplot(data.frame(pct=zero_pct, all=""), ggplot2::aes(x=pct, y=all)) +
      ggplot2::geom_col(width=.65, fill="#808A93") +
      ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(limits=c(0, 100), breaks=c(0, 50, 100),
        labels=c("0%", "50%", "100%"), expand=c(0, 0)) +
      ggplot2::labs(title=paste0("Zero cells: ", zero, "/", n, " samples (",
        format(signif(zero_pct, 2), trim=TRUE), "%)"), x=NULL, y=NULL) +
      ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size=8) +
      ggplot2::theme(plot.title=ggplot2::element_text(size=8.5),
        panel.grid=ggplot2::element_blank(), axis.text.y=ggplot2::element_blank(),
        plot.margin=ggplot2::margin(0, 8, 5, 5))
    patchwork::wrap_plots(top, bottom, ncol=1, heights=c(3.7, 1))
  })
  chunks <- split(seq_along(panels), ceiling(seq_along(panels) / 12))
  lapply(seq_along(chunks), function(k) {
    subtitle <- if (scale == "CLR") paste0(length(selected), " types with raw p < 0.05; ",
      sum(payload$results$q < .05), " / ", payload$n_types, " survive BH. ", payload$n_samples, " samples.")
    else paste0("Same ", length(selected), " CLR-selected types; p-values test percentages; BH across all ", payload$n_types, " types.")
    patchwork::wrap_plots(panels[chunks[[k]]], ncol=3, nrow=min(4L, ceiling(length(panels) / 3))) +
      patchwork::plot_annotation(title=paste(dataset, "|", if (scale == "CLR")
        "Cell-type CLR abundance by batch" else "Percentage-abundance diagnostic"), subtitle=subtitle,
        caption=paste0("Boxes: median/IQR; whiskers: 1.5 IQR. Crosses: outlier extremes; intermediate outliers omitted.\n",
          "Blue: BH < 0.05; gold: raw p < 0.05 only; gray: neither. Zero-count bars pool all samples.\n",
          if (dataset == "Lupus_PBMC") "Lupus retains the documented whole-sample majority_v1 policy. " else "",
          "Page ", k, "/", length(chunks)), theme=ggplot2::theme(
            plot.title=ggplot2::element_text(size=16, face="bold"),
            plot.subtitle=ggplot2::element_text(size=10.5),
            plot.caption=ggplot2::element_text(size=8, hjust=0)))
  })
}

becm_mds_rows <- function() {
  ids <- c("ECODA_authors_limma", paste0("ECODA_authors_sigdiff_ctdrop_", 1:3),
    "ECODA_Harmony_Leiden_CLR", "ECODA_Harmony_Leiden_CLR_limma",
    paste0("ECODA_Harmony_Leiden_CLR_sigdiff_ctdrop_", 1:3))
  data.frame(method_id=ids,
    baseline_id=c(rep("ECODA_authors_uncorrected", 4), rep("ECODA_Leiden_CLR_uncorrected", 5)),
    label=c("Authors + limma", paste0("Authors: drop, CLR cutoff ", 1:3),
      "Harmony / Leiden / CLR", "Harmony / Leiden / CLR + limma",
      paste0("Harmony: drop, CLR cutoff ", 1:3)), stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
}

becm_coordinates <- function(variant, sample_ids) {
  if (is.null(variant$dist_mat)) return(NULL)
  distance <- as.matrix(variant$dist_mat)
  stopifnot(identical(rownames(distance), sample_ids), identical(colnames(distance), sample_ids),
    all(is.finite(distance)), all(distance >= 0), max(abs(distance - t(distance))) < 1e-8,
    max(abs(diag(distance))) < 1e-8)
  if (max(distance) == 0) return(matrix(0, nrow=length(sample_ids), ncol=2,
    dimnames=list(sample_ids, c("MDS1", "MDS2"))))
  # Use the standard double-centred squared-distance matrix explicitly.
  squared <- distance^2
  gram <- -.5 * (squared - rowMeans(squared) - rep(colMeans(squared), each=nrow(squared)) + mean(squared))
  eig <- eigen(gram, symmetric=TRUE)
  keep <- which(eig$values > max(eig$values) * 1e-10)
  coords <- matrix(0, nrow=nrow(distance), ncol=2, dimnames=list(sample_ids, c("MDS1", "MDS2")))
  keep <- head(keep, 2L)
  if (length(keep)) coords[, seq_along(keep)] <- sweep(eig$vectors[, keep, drop=FALSE], 2, sqrt(eig$values[keep]), "*")
  coords
}

becm_count_label <- function(variant) {
  if (is.null(variant)) return("Missing variant")
  fields <- c(n_initial="initial", n_significant="BH significant", n_dropped="removed", n_remaining="remaining")
  available <- names(fields)[vapply(names(fields), function(key)
    length(variant[[key]]) == 1L && is.finite(variant[[key]]), logical(1))]
  paste(paste0(fields[available], " ", unlist(variant[available])), collapse="; ")
}

becm_mds_figure <- function(dataset, entry, scores) {
  metadata <- entry$metadata
  stopifnot(all(c("Sample", "bio", "batch") %in% names(metadata)),
    !anyNA(metadata[c("Sample", "bio", "batch")]), !anyDuplicated(metadata$Sample))
  ids <- as.character(metadata$Sample)
  rows <- becm_mds_rows()
  needed <- unique(c(rows$baseline_id, rows$method_id))
  stopifnot(all(needed %in% names(entry$variants)))
  coordinates <- setNames(lapply(entry$variants[needed], becm_coordinates, sample_ids=ids), needed)
  grouping <- c("bio", "bio", "batch", "batch")
  states <- c("Uncorrected", "Corrected", "Uncorrected", "Corrected")
  panels <- list()
  for (r in seq_len(nrow(rows))) for (column in 1:4) {
    id <- if (column %in% c(1L, 3L)) rows$baseline_id[r] else rows$method_id[r]
    variant <- entry$variants[[id]]
    coords <- coordinates[[id]]
    title <- paste0(if (column == 1L) rows$label[r] else "", "\n",
      if (grouping[column] == "bio") "Biology" else "Batch", " | ", states[column])
    if (is.null(coords)) {
      panel <- ggplot2::ggplot() + ggplot2::theme_void() +
        ggplot2::labs(title=title, subtitle=paste(
          paste(strwrap(paste("Unscorable:", variant$status), width=35), collapse="\n"),
          paste(strwrap(becm_count_label(variant), width=35), collapse="\n"), sep="\n"))
    } else {
      score <- scores[scores$dataset == dataset & scores$method_id == id, , drop=FALSE]
      stopifnot(nrow(score) == 1L)
      value <- score[[if (grouping[column] == "bio") "biological_anosim" else "batch_anosim"]]
      data <- data.frame(MDS1=coords[, 1], MDS2=coords[, 2],
        group=factor(metadata[[grouping[column]]], levels=sort(unique(metadata[[grouping[column]]]))))
      span <- max(abs(coords)) * 1.08
      if (span == 0) span <- 1
      panel <- ggplot2::ggplot(data, ggplot2::aes(x=MDS1, y=MDS2, colour=group)) +
        ggplot2::geom_point(size=1.4, alpha=.85) +
        ggplot2::coord_equal(xlim=c(-span, span), ylim=c(-span, span), expand=FALSE) +
        ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(labels=becm_axisformat, breaks=scales::breaks_pretty(n=3)) +
        ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(labels=becm_axisformat, breaks=scales::breaks_pretty(n=3)) +
        ggplot2::labs(title=title, subtitle=paste0("ANOSIM: ",
          if (is.finite(value)) sprintf("%.2f", value) else "unscorable", "\n",
          paste(strwrap(becm_count_label(variant), width=43), collapse="\n")), colour=NULL) +
        ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size=9) + ggplot2::theme(panel.grid.minor=ggplot2::element_blank(),
          legend.position="bottom", legend.text=ggplot2::element_text(size=7))
      if (grouping[column] == "batch") panel <- panel +
        ggplot2::scale_colour_discrete(labels=function(x) becm_short_batch(dataset, x))
    }
    panels[[length(panels) + 1L]] <- panel + ggplot2::theme(
      plot.title=ggplot2::element_text(size=10, face="bold"),
      plot.subtitle=ggplot2::element_text(size=8))
  }
  patchwork::wrap_plots(panels, ncol=4) + patchwork::plot_annotation(
    title=paste(dataset, "| ECODA batch-effect correction comparison"),
    subtitle="Columns: biological groups before / after correction; batches before / after correction.",
    caption=paste0("Distances are evaluated with ANOSIM; biological labels are evaluation-only. ",
      "Each variant uses the same MDS coordinates for biology and batch colouring.\n",
      "All Harmony rows share the non-Harmony Leiden uncorrected anchor. ",
      if (dataset == "Lupus_PBMC") "Lupus uses whole-sample majority_v1 batches." else ""),
    theme=ggplot2::theme(plot.title=ggplot2::element_text(size=17, face="bold"),
      plot.subtitle=ggplot2::element_text(size=11), plot.caption=ggplot2::element_text(size=9, hjust=0)))
}

becm_anosim_summary <- function(scores) {
  required <- c("dataset", "method_id", "threshold", "biological_anosim", "batch_anosim")
  stopifnot(all(required %in% names(scores)), !anyDuplicated(scores[c("dataset", "method_id")]))
  data <- scores
  author_drop <- grepl("^ECODA_authors_sigdiff_ctdrop_", data$method_id) & !grepl("droplow", data$method_id)
  harmony_drop <- grepl("^ECODA_Harmony_Leiden_CLR_sigdiff_ctdrop_", data$method_id)
  labels <- c(ECODA_authors_uncorrected="Authors: uncorrected",
    ECODA_Leiden_CLR_uncorrected="Leiden: uncorrected", ECODA_authors_limma="Authors + limma",
    ECODA_Harmony_Leiden_CLR="Harmony / Leiden / CLR",
    ECODA_Harmony_Leiden_CLR_limma="Harmony / Leiden / CLR + limma",
    ECODA_authors_sigdiff_ctdrop_2_droplow50pct="Authors: cutoff 2 + zero >=50%")
  data$series <- unname(labels[data$method_id])
  data$series[author_drop] <- "Authors: drop trajectory"
  data$series[harmony_drop] <- "Harmony: drop trajectory"
  stopifnot(!anyNA(data$series))
  data$valid <- is.finite(data$biological_anosim) & is.finite(data$batch_anosim)
  trajectory <- data[author_drop | harmony_drop, , drop=FALSE]
  trajectory <- trajectory[order(trajectory$dataset, trajectory$series, trajectory$threshold), ]
  groups <- interaction(trajectory$dataset, trajectory$series, drop=TRUE)
  trajectory$segment <- ave(as.integer(!trajectory$valid), groups, FUN=cumsum)
  trajectory$line <- interaction(trajectory$dataset, trajectory$series, trajectory$segment, drop=TRUE)
  # Preserve breaks at unscorable thresholds; never bridge an invalid entry.
  line_data <- trajectory[trajectory$valid, , drop=FALSE]
  points <- data[data$valid, , drop=FALSE]
  arrow_pairs <- list(
    c("ECODA_Leiden_CLR_uncorrected", "ECODA_Harmony_Leiden_CLR"),
    c("ECODA_Leiden_CLR_uncorrected", "ECODA_Harmony_Leiden_CLR_limma"),
    c("ECODA_authors_uncorrected", "ECODA_authors_limma"),
    c("ECODA_authors_uncorrected", "ECODA_authors_sigdiff_ctdrop_2_droplow50pct"))
  arrows <- do.call(rbind, lapply(arrow_pairs, function(pair) {
    from <- points[points$method_id == pair[1], c("dataset", "biological_anosim", "batch_anosim")]
    to <- points[points$method_id == pair[2], c("dataset", "biological_anosim", "batch_anosim", "series")]
    merge(from, to, by="dataset", suffixes=c("_from", "_to"))
  }))
  palette <- c("Authors: uncorrected"="#333333", "Leiden: uncorrected"="#999999",
    "Authors + limma"="#1B9E77", "Harmony / Leiden / CLR"="#377EB8",
    "Harmony / Leiden / CLR + limma"="#984EA3", "Authors: drop trajectory"="#D73027",
    "Harmony: drop trajectory"="#E68A00", "Authors: cutoff 2 + zero >=50%"="#A65628")
  shapes <- c("Authors: uncorrected"=1, "Leiden: uncorrected"=2,
    "Authors + limma"=17, "Harmony / Leiden / CLR"=15,
    "Harmony / Leiden / CLR + limma"=18, "Authors: drop trajectory"=16,
    "Harmony: drop trajectory"=16, "Authors: cutoff 2 + zero >=50%"=8)
  facet_labels <- setNames(vapply(unique(data$dataset), function(dataset) {
    initial <- data[data$dataset == dataset, ]
    authors <- initial$n_initial[initial$method_id == "ECODA_authors_uncorrected"]
    harmony <- initial$n_initial[initial$method_id == "ECODA_Harmony_Leiden_CLR"]
    stopifnot(length(authors) == 1L, length(harmony) == 1L)
    paste0(dataset, " (n cell types: ", authors, " author / ", harmony, " Harmony)")
  }, character(1)), unique(data$dataset))
  ggplot2::ggplot(points, ggplot2::aes(x=biological_anosim, y=batch_anosim,
    colour=series, shape=series)) +
    ggplot2::geom_segment(data=arrows, ggplot2::aes(
      x=biological_anosim_from, y=batch_anosim_from,
      xend=biological_anosim_to, yend=batch_anosim_to, colour=series),
      inherit.aes=FALSE, linewidth=.5, alpha=.8,
      arrow=grid::arrow(length=grid::unit(.10, "inches"), type="closed"), show.legend=FALSE) +
    ggplot2::geom_path(data=line_data, ggplot2::aes(group=line), linewidth=.6, show.legend=FALSE) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(size=2.2) +
    ggplot2::geom_text(data=line_data, ggplot2::aes(label=threshold),
      vjust=-.65, size=2.6, check_overlap=TRUE, show.legend=FALSE) +
    ggplot2::facet_wrap(~dataset, ncol=3,
      labeller=ggplot2::as_labeller(facet_labels)) +
    ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(values=palette, limits=names(palette), drop=FALSE) +
    ggplot2::scale_shape_manual(values=shapes, limits=names(shapes), drop=FALSE) +
    ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(labels=becm_axisformat, breaks=scales::breaks_pretty(n=4),
      expand=ggplot2::expansion(mult=.1)) +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(labels=becm_axisformat, breaks=scales::breaks_pretty(n=4),
      expand=ggplot2::expansion(mult=.1)) +
    ggplot2::labs(title="ECODA correction methods: biological versus batch separation",
      subtitle="Labels show CLR-difference cutoffs; paths follow 0, 0.5, ..., 4 in order.",
      x="Biological ANOSIM (higher separation)", y="Batch ANOSIM (higher separation)",
      colour=NULL, shape=NULL) +
    ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size=11) + ggplot2::theme(legend.position="bottom",
      legend.text=ggplot2::element_text(size=9), plot.caption=ggplot2::element_text(hjust=0)) +
    ggplot2::guides(colour=ggplot2::guide_legend(nrow=3, byrow=TRUE),
      shape=ggplot2::guide_legend(nrow=3, byrow=TRUE))
}
```

# Load the reviewed comparison cache

```{r becm-load-cache, eval=becm_render}
cache_path <- Sys.getenv("ECODA_BECM_CACHE", becm_default_cache)
cache_md5 <- Sys.getenv("ECODA_BECM_CACHE_MD5", becm_default_cache_md5)
stopifnot(file.exists(cache_path), grepl("^[0-9a-f]{32}$", cache_md5),
  identical(unname(tools::md5sum(cache_path)), cache_md5))
becm_cache <- readRDS(cache_path)
stopifnot(identical(unname(tools::md5sum(cache_path)), cache_md5),
  setequal(names(becm_cache$datasets), becm_dataset_ids),
  all(c("datasets", "scores", "boxplots") %in% names(becm_cache)))
```

# Cell-type abundance boxplots and zero-count diagnostics

Each main boxplot PDF includes all cell types with raw CLR p<0.05, with both
raw and BH-adjusted p-values. Blue boxes survive BH; gold boxes are raw-only.
The bar under each panel reports the fraction of samples with zero observed
cells across all batches. Missing a rare category can interact strongly with
the fixed pseudocount and changing CLR reference. The Stephenson percentage
companion helps distinguish reference-sensitive findings from visible changes
in cell proportions; its p-values test percentages and are labelled as such.

```{r becm-boxplots, eval=becm_render}
for (dataset in names(becm_cache$boxplots)) {
  payload <- becm_cache$boxplots[[dataset]]
  for (scale in if (is.null(payload$proportion_tests)) "CLR" else c("CLR", "Percentage")) {
    pages <- becm_boxplot_pages(payload, dataset, scale)
    n_selected <- sum(payload$results$p < .05)
    filename <- if (scale == "CLR") paste0(dataset, "_CLR_boxplots.pdf") else paste0(dataset, "_percentage_diagnostic.pdf")
    becm_save_pages(pages, file.path(becm_plot_root, "boxplots", filename),
      width=13, height=4 * max(1L, min(4L, ceiling(n_selected / 3))))
  }
  rm(payload, pages)
}
```

# MDS: nine rows by four columns for each dataset

The rows are author limma; author cell-type dropping at cutoffs 1, 2 and 3;
Harmony/Leiden CLR; Harmony/Leiden CLR + limma; and Harmony cell-type dropping
at cutoffs 1, 2 and 3. Columns show biology before and after correction, then
batch before and after correction. Row subtitles record original, significant,
removed and remaining category counts where applicable. A variant with too
few usable features remains explicitly unscorable instead of disappearing.

Classical metric MDS is computed from each persisted sample distance matrix
once and reused for both colourings. A rank-one representation receives a
zero second coordinate. Biological labels do not determine these coordinates.

```{r becm-mds, eval=becm_render}
for (dataset in becm_dataset_ids) {
  figure <- becm_mds_figure(dataset, becm_cache$datasets[[dataset]], becm_cache$scores)
  becm_save_pages(list(figure), file.path(becm_plot_root, "mds", paste0(dataset, "_mds.pdf")),
    width=11, height=31)
  rm(figure)
}
```

# ANOSIM summary and threshold trajectories

The x-axis is biological separation and the y-axis is batch separation; high
biological separation with low batch separation is desirable. The two cell-type
drop families follow thresholds `seq(0, 4, 0.5)` in increasing order. The
author threshold-2 plus zero-in-at-least-half variant is a separate point,
alongside the fixed comparators and two uncorrected anchors. Kidney contributes
its condition evaluation once. ANOSIM is shown on its original scale; no
cross-metric mean or min-max normalization is used in this approved figure.

```{r becm-summary, eval=becm_render}
figure <- becm_anosim_summary(becm_cache$scores)
becm_save_pages(list(figure), file.path(becm_plot_root, "summary", "ECODA_becm_comp_ANOSIM.pdf"),
  width=15, height=12)
utils::write.csv(becm_cache$scores,
  file.path(becm_plot_root, "ANOSIM_scores_and_cell_type_counts.csv"), row.names=FALSE)
rm(figure)
```

# Provenance and interpretation

The initial run produced all 168 requested dataset/method rows successfully.
Its numerical worker is bound to commit `79cb9e6943a48cbb918ea62697fd5facce10506d`,
selection MD5 `90566e8151a86f5ba4a7f027f5794dff`, and worker MD5
`6522f2947abb202d176ea8df8198bead`. Bamboo job `4715509` completed in 22 seconds
with R 4.5.2 and vegan 2.7.5. The compact local cache above is sufficient for
all figure iteration. An independent audit reproduced all 336 ANOSIM values
from the cached distances; maximum absolute difference was 1.5e-14.

The original maintainable scientific and plotting helpers have been
centralized here. Exact historical source text remains in frozen execution
snapshots and the new run's `legacy_*_migration.rds` metadata receipts.

The `boxplots/relocation.tsv` table records the byte-identical relocation of
the earlier six-dataset figures into this structure. Old checksum inventories
remain historical evidence and retain their original recorded paths. Frozen
`run_*` scripts also remain as evidence; all maintained scientific and plotting
code now lives in this notebook.

Lupus retains the previously approved **whole-sample** cohort with majority_v1
sample batch labels. Those 94 samples contain cells from 17 raw batches, even
though seven majority groups enter the sample-level comparison. The separate
November 11 cohort audit documents a potential strict cell-level alternative;
this notebook does not silently change that scientific cohort definition.

These are exploratory batch associations in relative compositions. They do
not establish absolute cell abundance changes or independent technical causes.
Removing features chosen using batch labels targets batch separation by
construction. Biological recovery is therefore reported alongside batch
separation, and thresholds remain visible rather than selecting the best one
using biological labels.

# Additional figure: all available historical cohort versions

This separate, three-page figure deliberately includes cohorts disabled in
the current production configuration. It does not change `datasets.json` or
replace the final-seven figure. The 25 panels cover 13 distinct dataset IDs:
seven current filtered versions, seven historical paired versions plus one mixed-contract Lupus and one
Alzheimer corrected-only version, and nine broader historical versions.
"Historical" means before the final November confounding exclusions, not
completely unfiltered raw data.

Current panels reuse all existing methods and threshold trajectories. Legacy
panels compare author CLR only: the old unsupervised correction key does not
establish the two modern Harmony identities, so it is not relabelled as either.
Matching historical corrections are plotted from their existing distances.
For broader versions without a matching correction, limma is fitted locally
to the tiny saved sample CLR matrix using only the configured technical batch
columns and an intercept. No biological variable is protected or fitted.
Multiple varying configured columns define a joint batch axis for evaluation;
limma uses their additive indicator design. This is explicitly exploratory.
Myocardial_infarction's historical configuration includes patient as a batch
column; its title exposes that problematic choice rather than presenting it
as an unconfounded technical correction.

Facet titles report sample and author-type counts, cohort status, unavailable
methods and how many batches contain only one biological group. Zero such
batches does not establish absence of confounding: imbalanced group fractions
can remain. The old 45-sample Kidney_KPMP has no configured batch column and
is retained as an unscorable panel. Alzheimer104 has no matching historical
uncorrected IDs and is shown as a corrected-only point, without an arrow.
Drop curves are omitted when any batch has fewer than two samples; missing
methods and unscorable results are never replaced with zero scores.

The historical corrected-distance JSON is a checksum-checked metadata export
of existing Bamboo results. It contains distances and sample metadata, never
CLR, counts, expression data or fitted models. All new calculations and plots
run locally. The generated cache contains scores, panel metadata and source
references, not sample feature matrices.

```{r becm-all-available-functions}
becm_historical_check <- function(path) {
  expected <- sub("^MD5=", "", grep("^MD5=", readLines(paste0(path, ".md5")), value=TRUE))
  stopifnot(length(expected)==1L, identical(unname(tools::md5sum(path)), expected))
  expected
}

becm_all_available <- function(corrected_json, current_cache) {
  cfg <- jsonlite::fromJSON("datasets.json", simplifyVector=FALSE)
  corrected <- lapply(readLines(corrected_json), jsonlite::fromJSON)
  names(corrected) <- vapply(corrected, `[[`, character(1), "dataset")
  all_rows <- panels <- provenance <- list()
  panel_number <- 0L
  add <- function(ds, id, category, status, problem, metadata, variants, n_types) {
    panel_number <<- panel_number+1L
    panel <- paste(ds,id,sep="__")
    batch <- metadata$batch; bio <- metadata$bio
    good <- length(unique(batch))>=2L && length(unique(batch))<length(batch)
    invalid <- sum(vapply(variants,function(v)is.null(v$dist_mat),logical(1)))
    if(invalid>0L) problem <- paste0(problem,"; ",invalid," unscorable settings (curve gaps)")
    rows <- lapply(names(variants),function(key) {
      v <- variants[[key]]
      score <- function(labels) {
        if(is.null(v$dist_mat) || length(unique(labels))<2L || length(unique(labels))>=length(labels)) return(NA_real_)
        becm_anosim(v$dist_mat,labels)
      }
      data.frame(panel_id=panel,dataset=ds,status=status,problem=problem,n_samples=nrow(metadata),
        n_types=n_types,method_id=key,threshold=v$threshold,
        method_status=if(!good) "UNSCORABLE_NO_BATCH" else if(!is.null(v$status)) v$status else "PASS",
        n_remaining=if(is.null(v$n_remaining)) NA_integer_ else v$n_remaining,
        biological_anosim=score(bio),batch_anosim=if(good)score(if(is.null(v$batch_labels)) batch else v$batch_labels) else NA_real_)
    })
    all_rows[[panel]] <<- do.call(rbind,rows)
    panels[[panel]] <<- data.frame(panel_id=panel,page=category,dataset=ds,status=status,problem=problem,
      n_samples=nrow(metadata),n_types=n_types)
  }
  for(ds in names(current_cache$datasets)) {
    d <- current_cache$datasets[[ds]]
    problem <- if(ds=="Lupus_PBMC") "Whole-sample majority batches; off-list cells retained" else
      if(ds=="Kidney_KPMP_full") "Condition only; residual confounding possible" else "Final confounding exclusions applied"
    add(ds,"current","Current filtered","Current filtered",problem,d$metadata,d$variants,
      d$variants$ECODA_authors_uncorrected$n_initial)
  }
  datasets <- c("Alzheimer","Breast_cancer","CombinedPBMC","Covid19_PBMC","Diabetes","Joanito",
    "Kidney_KPMP","Kidney_KPMP_full","Lung","Lupus_PBMC","Myocardial_infarction","Parkinson","Stephenson")
  for(ds in datasets) {
    file <- file.path("data/batch_effect/uncorrected/results",paste0(ds,"_batch_effect_uncorrected_composition.rds"))
    mp <- file.path("data/batch_effect/uncorrected/metadata",paste0(ds,"_sample_metadata.feather"))
    md5 <- becm_historical_check(file); mmd5 <- becm_historical_check(mp)
    z <- readRDS(file)$ECODA_authors_HR
    metadata <- as.data.frame(arrow::read_feather(mp))
    roles <- list(broad=list(file=file,md5=md5,z=z,metadata=metadata))
    intermediate <- file.path("data/batch_effect/uncorrected_final/results",paste0(ds,"_batch_effect_uncorrected_final_composition.rds"))
    if(file.exists(intermediate)) {
      imd5 <- becm_historical_check(intermediate)
      iz <- readRDS(intermediate)$ECODA_authors_HR
      if(!setequal(rownames(z$feat_mat),rownames(iz$feat_mat)))
        roles$intermediate <- list(file=intermediate,md5=imd5,z=iz,metadata=metadata)
    }
    for(version in names(roles)) {
      entry <- roles[[version]]; z <- entry$z
      ids <- rownames(z$feat_mat); clr <- as.matrix(z$feat_mat)
      stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(ids),!anyDuplicated(entry$metadata$Sample),all(ids%in%entry$metadata$Sample))
      m <- entry$metadata[match(ids,entry$metadata$Sample),,drop=FALSE]
      batch_columns <- unlist(cfg[[ds]]$columns$batch)
      stopifnot(all(batch_columns%in%names(m)))
      batch_columns <- batch_columns[vapply(batch_columns,function(k)length(unique(m[[k]]))>1L,logical(1))]
      batch_data <- m[,batch_columns,drop=FALSE]
      batch <- if(length(batch_columns)) as.character(do.call(interaction,c(lapply(batch_data,factor),list(drop=TRUE,sep=" | ")))) else rep("No configured batch",length(ids))
      meta <- data.frame(Sample=ids,bio=as.character(m[[cfg[[ds]]$columns$label]]),batch=batch)
      stopifnot(!anyNA(meta),all(is.finite(clr)))
      counts <- as.matrix(z$counts)[ids,,drop=FALSE] - 0.5
      stopifnot(all(counts>=0),max(abs(counts-round(counts)))<1e-8)
      colnames(clr) <- colnames(counts)
      variants <- list(ECODA_authors_uncorrected=becm_variant(clr,"authors_uncorrected","uncorrected"))
      stored <- corrected[[ds]]
      paired <- !is.null(stored) && setequal(ids,stored$ids)
      category <- if(paired) "Historical correction results" else "Broader historical"
      status <- if(paired) "Historical paired; pre-final exclusions" else "Broader historical; locally derived limma"
      issues <- c("Author CLR only; Harmony not compared")
      if(length(unique(batch))>=2L) {
        tab <- table(meta$bio,meta$batch)
        issues <- c(issues,paste0(sum(colSums(tab>0)==1),"/",ncol(tab)," batches have one bio group"))
      }
      if(paired) {
        distance <- as.matrix(stored$distance);dimnames(distance)<-list(stored$ids,stored$ids)
        distance <- stats::as.dist(distance[ids,ids,drop=FALSE])
        variants$ECODA_authors_limma <- list(dist_mat=distance,threshold=NA_real_)
        issues <- c(issues,"Stored legacy limma; historical contract")
        cm <- stored$metadata[match(ids,stored$metadata$Sample),,drop=FALSE]
        stopifnot(identical(as.character(cm[[cfg[[ds]]$columns$label]]),meta$bio))
        changed <- sum(vapply(batch_columns,function(k)
          sum(as.character(m[[k]])!=as.character(cm[[k]])),integer(1)))
        if(changed>0L) {
          variants$ECODA_authors_limma$batch_labels <- as.character(do.call(interaction,
            c(lapply(cm[,batch_columns,drop=FALSE],factor),list(drop=TRUE,sep=" | "))))
          issues <- c(issues,paste0(changed," sample batch labels differ; COR evaluated with its own labels"))
        }
        if(changed>0L || ncol(clr)!=stored$n_types)
          status <- "Historical mixed contracts; not a paired correction"
        if(ncol(clr)!=stored$n_types) issues <- c(issues,paste0(
          "Annotation basis differs: UNC ",ncol(clr)," / COR ",stored$n_types,"; no limma arrow"))
      } else if(length(batch_columns)) {
        design <- stats::model.matrix(~.,data=lapply(batch_data,factor))
        if(qr(design)$rank==ncol(design) && ncol(design)<nrow(design)) {
          corrected_clr <- t(limma::removeBatchEffect(t(clr),covariates=design[,-1,drop=FALSE],
            design=matrix(1,nrow(clr),1)))
          variants$ECODA_authors_limma <- becm_variant(corrected_clr,"authors_limma","corrected")
        } else issues <- c(issues,"Limma omitted: aliased/saturated batch design")
      } else {
        status <- "Unscorable batch comparison"
        issues <- c(issues,"No configured batch column; no batch score or limma")
      }
      if(length(batch_columns)>1L) issues <- c(issues,paste0("Joint batch axis: ",paste(batch_columns,collapse=" + ")))
      if(length(unique(batch))>=2L && all(table(batch)>=2L)) {
        screen <- becm_screen(clr,batch,counts)
        for(t in seq(0,4,.5)) {
          dropped <- becm_drop(clr,screen,t)
          variants[[paste0("ECODA_authors_sigdiff_ctdrop_",becm_threshold_id(t))]] <-
            becm_variant(dropped$feat_mat,"authors_drop","corrected",t,dropped)
        }
        dropped <- becm_drop(clr,screen,2,TRUE)
        variants$ECODA_authors_sigdiff_ctdrop_2_droplow50pct <- becm_variant(dropped$feat_mat,"authors_drop_sparse","corrected",2,dropped)
      } else issues <- c(issues,"Drop curves omitted: missing/under-replicated batches")
      add(ds,version,category,status,paste(issues,collapse="; "),meta,variants,ncol(clr))
      provenance[[paste(ds,version)]] <- list(file=entry$file,md5=entry$md5,metadata=mp,metadata_md5=mmd5,
        corrected_source=if(paired)stored$source else NULL,corrected_md5=if(paired)stored$md5 else NULL,
        batch_columns=batch_columns,method=if(paired)"Existing historical correction" else "New local batch-only limma on saved CLR")
    }
    rm(z,metadata,roles,clr,counts,m);invisible(gc(FALSE))
  }
  # The old Alzheimer correction uses a different ID scheme from its 83-sample baseline.
  z <- corrected$Alzheimer
  distance <- as.matrix(z$distance);dimnames(distance)<-list(z$ids,z$ids)
  m <- z$metadata
  add("Alzheimer","corrected_only","Historical correction results","Historical corrected-only; unmatched baseline",
    "104 corrected samples vs incompatible 83-sample baseline; no connecting arrow; legacy limma only",
    data.frame(Sample=z$ids,bio=m[[cfg$Alzheimer$columns$label]],batch=m[[cfg$Alzheimer$columns$batch]]),
    list(ECODA_authors_limma=list(dist_mat=stats::as.dist(distance),threshold=NA_real_)),z$n_types)
  list(scores=do.call(rbind,all_rows),panels=do.call(rbind,panels),sources=provenance,
    corrected_sources=lapply(corrected,function(x)x[c("dataset","source","md5","metadata_md5")]),
    scope="Exploratory historical cohorts, including disabled cohorts; current production configuration unchanged")
}
# Same endpoint colours and trajectories as the maintained seven-cohort plot,
# while retaining historical panels that lack one or more comparators.
becm_all_available_panel_plot <- function(data) {
  author_drop <- grepl("^ECODA_authors_sigdiff_ctdrop_", data$method_id) & !grepl("droplow", data$method_id)
  harmony_drop <- grepl("^ECODA_Harmony_Leiden_CLR_sigdiff_ctdrop_", data$method_id)
  labels <- c(ECODA_authors_uncorrected="Authors: uncorrected",
    ECODA_Leiden_CLR_uncorrected="Leiden: uncorrected", ECODA_authors_limma="Authors + limma",
    ECODA_Harmony_Leiden_CLR="Harmony / Leiden / CLR",
    ECODA_Harmony_Leiden_CLR_limma="Harmony / Leiden / CLR + limma",
    ECODA_authors_sigdiff_ctdrop_2_droplow50pct="Authors: cutoff 2 + zero >=50%")
  data$series <- unname(labels[data$method_id])
  data$series[author_drop] <- "Authors: drop trajectory"
  data$series[harmony_drop] <- "Harmony: drop trajectory"
  stopifnot(!anyNA(data$series))
  data$valid <- is.finite(data$biological_anosim) & is.finite(data$batch_anosim)
  trajectory <- data[author_drop | harmony_drop, , drop=FALSE]
  trajectory <- trajectory[order(trajectory$dataset, trajectory$series, trajectory$threshold), ]
  trajectory$line <- character(nrow(trajectory))
  if (nrow(trajectory)) {
    groups <- interaction(trajectory$dataset, trajectory$series, drop=TRUE)
    segment <- ave(as.integer(!trajectory$valid), groups, FUN=cumsum)
    trajectory$line <- interaction(trajectory$dataset, trajectory$series, segment, drop=TRUE)
  }
  line_data <- trajectory[trajectory$valid, , drop=FALSE]
  palette <- c("Authors: uncorrected"="#333333", "Leiden: uncorrected"="#999999",
    "Authors + limma"="#1B9E77", "Harmony / Leiden / CLR"="#377EB8",
    "Harmony / Leiden / CLR + limma"="#984EA3", "Authors: drop trajectory"="#D73027",
    "Harmony: drop trajectory"="#E68A00", "Authors: cutoff 2 + zero >=50%"="#A65628")
  shapes <- c("Authors: uncorrected"=1, "Leiden: uncorrected"=2,
    "Authors + limma"=17, "Harmony / Leiden / CLR"=15,
    "Harmony / Leiden / CLR + limma"=18, "Authors: drop trajectory"=16,
    "Harmony: drop trajectory"=16, "Authors: cutoff 2 + zero >=50%"=8)
  present <- names(palette)[names(palette) %in% data$series]
  axisformat <- function(x) format(signif(x, 2), trim=TRUE, scientific=FALSE)
  ggplot2::ggplot(data[data$valid, ], ggplot2::aes(x=biological_anosim, y=batch_anosim,
      colour=series, shape=series)) +
    ggplot2::geom_path(data=line_data, ggplot2::aes(group=line), linewidth=.6, show.legend=FALSE) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(size=2.2) +
    ggplot2::geom_text(data=line_data, ggplot2::aes(label=threshold), vjust=-.65,
      size=2.6, check_overlap=TRUE, show.legend=FALSE) +
    ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(values=palette, limits=present, drop=FALSE) +
    ggplot2::scale_shape_manual(values=shapes, limits=present, drop=FALSE) +
    ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(labels=axisformat, breaks=scales::breaks_pretty(n=4),
      expand=ggplot2::expansion(mult=.1)) +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(labels=axisformat, breaks=scales::breaks_pretty(n=4),
      expand=ggplot2::expansion(mult=.1)) +
    ggplot2::labs(x="Biological ANOSIM (higher separation)",
      y="Batch ANOSIM (higher separation)", colour=NULL, shape=NULL) +
    ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size=11) + ggplot2::theme(legend.position="bottom",
      legend.text=ggplot2::element_text(size=9)) +
    ggplot2::guides(colour=ggplot2::guide_legend(nrow=3, byrow=TRUE),
      shape=ggplot2::guide_legend(nrow=3, byrow=TRUE))
}

becm_all_available_pages <- function(scores, page_groups = NULL,
                                     max_panels = 9L, columns = 3L) {
  fields <- c("panel_id", "dataset", "status", "problem", "n_samples", "n_types",
    "method_id", "biological_anosim", "batch_anosim", "threshold")
  stopifnot(is.data.frame(scores), nrow(scores) > 0L, all(fields %in% names(scores)),
    !anyNA(scores[c("panel_id", "dataset", "status", "problem", "method_id")]),
    !anyDuplicated(scores[c("panel_id", "method_id")]),
    max_panels >= 1L, columns >= 1L)
  info <- unique(scores[c("panel_id", "dataset", "status", "problem", "n_samples", "n_types")])
  stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(info$panel_id))
  if (is.null(page_groups)) page_groups <- setNames(info$status, info$panel_id)
  stopifnot(!is.null(names(page_groups)), !anyDuplicated(names(page_groups)),
    all(info$panel_id %in% names(page_groups)), !anyNA(page_groups[info$panel_id]),
    all(nzchar(page_groups[info$panel_id])))
  info$page_group <- unname(page_groups[info$panel_id])
  wrap <- function(x) paste(strwrap(x, width = 60), collapse = "\n")
  number <- function(x) if (is.finite(x)) format(x, trim = TRUE, scientific = FALSE) else "unavailable"
  info$facet_title <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(info)), function(i) {
    z <- info[i, ]
    paste(c(paste0(z$dataset, " | n=", number(z$n_samples),
      "; author types=", number(z$n_types)), wrap(z$status),
      if (nzchar(trimws(z$problem))) wrap(z$problem)), collapse = "\n")
  }, character(1))
  stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(info$facet_title))
  pairs <- data.frame(
    before = c("ECODA_authors_uncorrected", "ECODA_authors_uncorrected",
      "ECODA_Leiden_CLR_uncorrected", "ECODA_Leiden_CLR_uncorrected"),
    after = c("ECODA_authors_limma", "ECODA_authors_sigdiff_ctdrop_2_droplow50pct",
      "ECODA_Harmony_Leiden_CLR", "ECODA_Harmony_Leiden_CLR_limma"),
    series = c("Authors + limma", "Authors: cutoff 2 + zero >=50%",
      "Harmony / Leiden / CLR", "Harmony / Leiden / CLR + limma"))
  pages <- list()
  for (category in unique(info$page_group)) {
    selected <- info$panel_id[info$page_group == category]
    chunks <- split(selected, ceiling(seq_along(selected) / max_panels))
    for (k in seq_along(chunks)) {
      panel_ids <- chunks[[k]]
      rows <- scores[scores$panel_id %in% panel_ids, , drop = FALSE]
      labels <- info$facet_title[match(panel_ids, info$panel_id)]
      # The existing helper keys by dataset. These titles distinguish current
      # and historical versions of a cohort rather than pooling their scores.
      rows$dataset <- factor(info$facet_title[match(rows$panel_id, info$panel_id)],
        levels = labels)
      arrows <- list()
      for (panel in panel_ids) for (j in seq_len(nrow(pairs))) {
        if (pairs$after[j] == "ECODA_authors_limma" &&
            any(grepl("Annotation basis differs", rows$problem[rows$panel_id == panel], fixed=TRUE))) next
        before <- rows[rows$panel_id == panel & rows$method_id == pairs$before[j], , drop = FALSE]
        after <- rows[rows$panel_id == panel & rows$method_id == pairs$after[j], , drop = FALSE]
        if (nrow(before) != 1L || nrow(after) != 1L) next
        values <- c(before$biological_anosim, before$batch_anosim,
          after$biological_anosim, after$batch_anosim)
        if (!all(is.finite(values))) next
        arrows[[length(arrows) + 1L]] <- data.frame(dataset = after$dataset,
          x = values[1], y = values[2], xend = values[3], yend = values[4],
          series = pairs$series[j])
      }
      plot <- becm_all_available_panel_plot(rows)
      # Keep a visibly labelled facet even if all methods are unscorable.
      blank <- data.frame(dataset = factor(labels, levels = labels),
        biological_anosim = NA_real_, batch_anosim = NA_real_)
      plot <- plot + ggplot2::geom_blank(data = blank,
        ggplot2::aes(x = biological_anosim, y = batch_anosim), inherit.aes = FALSE)
      if (length(arrows)) plot <- plot + ggplot2::geom_segment(
        data = do.call(rbind, arrows),
        ggplot2::aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend, colour = series),
        inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = .45, alpha = .8,
        arrow = grid::arrow(length = grid::unit(1.8, "mm")), show.legend = FALSE)
      plot <- plot + ggplot2::facet_wrap(~dataset, ncol = columns, drop = FALSE) +
        ggplot2::labs(title = paste("ECODA ANOSIM comparison |", category),
          subtitle = paste0(length(panel_ids), " cohort panels; page ", k, "/", length(chunks),
            ". Threshold curves follow 0, 0.5, ..., 4."),
          caption = NULL) +
        ggplot2::theme(strip.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 8.5, lineheight = .95),
          plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 15, face = "bold"),
          plot.subtitle = ggplot2::element_text(size = 10),
          plot.caption = ggplot2::element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0))
      pages[[paste(category, k, sep = " / ")]] <- plot
    }
  }
  attr(pages, "panel_index") <- info
  pages
}
```

The saved all-available cache can be plotted locally without recomputing methods.

```{r becm-all-available-render, eval=FALSE}
broad_root <- file.path(getwd(), 'data', 'derived', 'ECODA_becm_all_available_20261120_v1')
broad <- becm_checked_rds(file.path(broad_root,'all_available_cache.final.rds'),'765c62ef1143e8b48a1d8d44efb2c1a6')
page_order <- c('Current filtered','Historical correction results','Broader historical')
panel_order <- broad$panels$panel_id[order(match(broad$panels$page,page_order))]
broad$scores <- broad$scores[order(match(broad$scores$panel_id,panel_order)), ]
page_groups <- setNames(broad$panels$page,broad$panels$panel_id)
pages_all <- becm_all_available_pages(broad$scores,page_groups)
becm_save_pages(pages_all,file.path(becm_plot_root,'summary','ECODA_becm_comp_ANOSIM_all_available.pdf'),17,16)
```

For a deliberate refresh, run `becm_all_available()` with the preserved historical JSON and the reviewed current cache. Its inputs and source MD5s are recorded in the all-available run directory.
